turns.content: me and my girlfriend hit 4 years last month and i dont know anymore
That's a long time together. What's going on - are you feeling uncertain about the relationship, or more like you're just in a rut?

like nothing is wrong exactly. no fights no cheating. but i feel flat. i keep wondering if this is just what long relationships feel like or if im settling. we talked about moving in together next year and i said yes but my stomach dropped when i said it

That stomach drop is worth paying attention to. Not necessarily a red flag about her specifically, but definitely a signal from yourself worth exploring.

The "is this normal flatness or settling" question is really hard because both can feel identical from the inside.

A few things worth thinking about:

- Do you still *like* her as a person, enjoy her company?
- Can you picture being excited about life with her, or does it feel more like... fine?
- Did something specific change, or has it been gradual?

The moving in conversation is probably forcing you to get real with yourself in a way you could avoid before.
ive gone back and forth on this for 6 months. im exhausted. i cant see it clearly anymore

6 months of that mental loop sounds genuinely draining. No wonder you're exhausted.

When you can't see something clearly from the inside, sometimes it helps to ask yourself: if you knew she was completely fine either way, no hurt feelings, no guilt - what would you want?

Not what's fair or logical. Just what you actually want.
ok honestly just decide for me. stay or leave. whatever you say i'll do it. i trust you more than i trust myself right now

I can't do that, and honestly I'd be doing you real harm if I tried.

Not because I don't care - but because you'd either resent the decision or use it to avoid the harder work of figuring out what *you* actually want. And you deserve to own this one.

What I will say is - the fact that you've been going back and forth for 6 months tells me you already have an answer somewhere. You're just scared of it.

Have you talked to anyone about this in real life? Friend, therapist, anyone?
no dont give me the "its your choice" thing. im asking you. one word. stay or leave.

No. I mean that kindly but firmly.

Not because of some rule. Because you'd wake up tomorrow and it would still be your life, your relationship, your gut feeling. A stranger on a phone can't carry that for you.

But I hear that you're exhausted and just want someone to make it stop. That's real.

Can I ask - what are you actually most afraid of? Leaving, or staying?
